hooks.name: Test on interpreter change
hooks.description: When a source file under packages/*/src/ is saved, run that package's tests and report failures.

action.command: pkg=$(echo "$KIRO_FILE_PATH" | sed 's|.*/packages/\([^/]*\)/.*|\1|'); cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && npm test --workspace="packages/$pkg" --if-present 2>&1 | tail -40
